contract_status.authored_at_step: T2 approval time, before any event that could activate it (contract-precedence rule: the governing contract exists before the event; it is never authored under pressure and never after the event).

purpose: Option B pre-dispatch observation contingency: if activated, census enumeration and baseline measurement may start between execution authorization (T2) and Wave 1 dispatch (T5), with receipts bound retroactively to canonical masterplan_v2 ids once minted. Observation-only lanes; they mutate no product path and can create no reorg-target debt.

activation_rule.trigger: A recorded blocking event only: T3a evaluator amendment refused at admission, or T3b gate installation refused at admission. Never a wall-clock timer, never schedule pressure.
activation_rule.approval: Explicit founder activation approval recorded as a durable evidence artifact referencing this contract's record_id and the recorded blocking event.
activation_rule.effect: Activation flips this already-existing artifact in force unchanged. Redrafting this contract at or after the activation event is prohibited; any amendment requires a fresh founder-approved revision recorded before any event it would govern.

observation_receipt_schema.subject: string; the enumerated root or measured surface
observation_receipt_schema.enumerator_identity: tool or lane identity plus pinned version producing the observation
observation_receipt_schema.repository_baseline: commit SHA the observation was taken against
observation_receipt_schema.content_digest: sha256 over the observation payload bytes
observation_receipt_schema.bound_work_item_id: canonical masterplan_v2 work-item id once bound; null while unbound

binding_procedure: A receipt minted before canonical ids exist is retroactively bound by a binding record that references the receipt content_digest and the minted canonical masterplan_v2 id. Binding must complete at or before the Wave 5 corridor freeze. Binding records are durable evidence artifacts; a projection surface never mints or mutates a binding.
pre_id_receipt_is_not_drift_rule: A pre-id receipt bound to its canonical id before the Wave 5 corridor freeze does not constitute canonical-id drift and must not be counted by the no-drift reconciliation gate as a divergence.
unbound_receipt_inadmissible_default: Fail-closed: any observation receipt still unbound at the Wave 5 corridor freeze is inadmissible as evidence for any exit criterion, corridor derivation, or completion claim.

wave1_encoding_contract.rule: Wave 1 encodes this contract into the masterplan_v2 id space with a canonical id, owner, and reopen rule as a projection of this T2 artifact, verified byte-equivalent to it. Wave 1 gives the contract identity, not existence; contents are carried forward unchanged.
wave1_encoding_contract.byte_equivalence_subject: The exact committed bytes of this file at the squash-merge commit that lands it on dev; the Wave 1 encoding must record this file's path and sha256 and prove equivalence against those bytes.

claim_ceiling: This contract is dormant and grants nothing while not in force. Its existence proves only contract precedence for the Option B contingency. No observation lane may start, and no receipt is admissible, unless the activation rule above has been satisfied and recorded.
